## 2. Signature Shadow moves

| Move | Rules |
| --- | --- |
| **Storm Without a Song** | 120 power, hits all foes; a Pokémon at full bond with its trainer takes half. It has no Corruption cost: XD001 was built so that using its power would never weaken the lock. Announced one turn ahead ("The wind forgets its tune."). |
| **Mind Vault** | 100 power; the target's held item and ability are sealed for 2 turns; the user cannot use it twice in a row. Cost: +6 Corruption. Announced one turn ahead ("The armor hums."). |
| **Yesterday's Thorn** | 80 power; at the end of the next turn the target takes the same damage again ("It already happened."). The echo can be blocked by Protect. Cost: +6 Corruption. Announced one turn ahead ("The air smells of last autumn."). |
| **Drowned Sky** | 110 power, hits all foes; brings a heavy rain for 3 turns in which Fire moves fail. Cost: +6 Corruption. Announced one turn ahead ("The ceiling is weeping."). |
| **Scorched Dawn** | 110 power, hits all foes; brings an extreme sun for 3 turns in which Water moves fail. Cost: +6 Corruption. Announced one turn ahead ("The stone begins to glow."). |
| **Stopped Clock** | 100 power; the target's next move is delayed until the end of the following turn. Cost: +6 Corruption. Announced one turn ahead ("The second hand hesitates."). |
| **Folded Distance** | 100 power; after it hits, the target is swapped with a random Pokémon from its trainer's bench. Cost: +6 Corruption. Announced one turn ahead ("The far wall is suddenly near."). |
| **Empty Crown** | 110 power; if the target has any stat boosts, they are taken from it and given to the user. Cost: +6 Corruption. Announced one turn ahead ("The cold reaches for something to wear."). |
| **Borrowed Years** | 100 power; heals the user by half the damage dealt; the target's maximum HP is lowered by 1/8 for the rest of the battle. Cost: +6 Corruption. Announced one turn ahead ("The light dims around it."). |
| **Keepsake** | 90 power; the target is sealed in glass until the end of the next turn: it cannot act and cannot be harmed. Cost: +6 Corruption. Announced one turn ahead ("She is choosing what to keep."). |
| **Red Star** | 110 power; double damage to a Dynamaxed target; the target's side cannot Dynamax or Mega Evolve for 3 turns. Cost: +6 Corruption. Announced one turn ahead ("The clouds turn the color of a wound."). |
| **Starfall Barrage** | five hits of 22 power, one each of Dark, Fire, Poison, Fairy and Fighting type; each hit that is super effective adds +2 Corruption to the user. Cost: +6 Corruption. Announced one turn ahead ("Five engines turn over at once."). |
